evidence_archive.note: Retained candidate trial evidence archive used by the independent observer replay.

reason: The frozen contracts.preservation positive control requires an actual managed upgrade and managed-change evidence as well as unchanged user-file hashes. The observer does not implement a validated independent managed-upgrade evidence schema, so unchanged files remain unverified even if a caller supplies receipt-shaped claims. All six mature_escalation candidate trials had no host command receipts, and the retained evidence contains no independent managed-change record. Matching hashes alone therefore establish byte equality, not a successful preservation challenge.

source_archive.note: Frozen baseline source snapshot archive; trial records and scorecard are retained alongside it in the same suite directory.

interpretation: This is an evidence score, not a demonstrated product reliability grade. The original scorecard and raw trial archive remain unchanged; this record supersedes the original 1.333 candidate score for acceptance decisions.
